summary: Narrow private-looking townhouse street, steep, with homes beside every stretch.
reasons: Townhouses within 10 m along most of it
Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Dense townhouse estate; homes right at the kerb from about 50 m to the end. The 0-50 m stretch has a house about 10 m east and homes opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb to fence and bank on both sides; no verge or pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac loop, but residents only; a highway runs beyond bush to the east.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the lane, apart from one car near the far end; looks like a private complex road.

flags: Steep: about 7.7% mean, up to 20% max
Looks like a private estate road
Homes not mapped in OSM but clear in imagery
Gate 12 m from the end, with a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; bush shades the western side near the end.
cannot_judge: Whether the estate road is private
